items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: Yes, I made some records with him.

ctx.x: I work with Kazimer in orchestra. In the orchestra? In the orchestra, not in the brass band. I work in the brass band.
Did you work with him when Wooden Joe used to be with him? Wooden Joe Nicholas? Wooden Joe, you remember Joe? Yes, I made some records with him.
He used to play right over here in Los Angeles.
